_comment: An EXAMPLE position for POST /api/v1/fx/state/import. The figures are made up.
They are round on purpose so every derived number comes out exact and a wrong
answer is obvious: against the 1.6000 baseline the four conversions below give
confirmed 10,732.50, estimated 6,000.00, total 16,732.50, and the offset costs
exactly 6.00 a day. Replace all of it with your own figures before importing.
current_source_balance is the balance AFTER these conversions. The importer
writes it exactly as given and does not decrement it again - that is what makes
this backfill rather than four live recordings.
notes: Example position. Replace with your own figures.

_comment: The amount converted is omitted because only the receipt and the rate are
known. The importer derives it by algebra (34,000 / 1.7 = 20,000 exactly),
which is not an estimate, so this row is NOT flagged. The fee is genuinely
unrecorded, and stays null rather than being written down as zero - the
improvement is reported with fee_unrecorded set instead.

_comment: The amount received is a reconstruction, not a receipt, so the row carries
amounts_estimated. Everything derived from it is reported beside the
confirmed total rather than added into it. Enter the real receipt later and
the flag clears and the split collapses on its own.
